# F-index of knots

Computed with all tree diagrams with up to n = 10 leaves (preliminary table; the full one for n ≤ 13 will be results/F_index_table.md): a knot that is not listed has F-index > 10 (or is the unknot, F-index 1).
Knots up to mirror image, KnotInfo names. The representative is an element of F realizing the knot with F-index leaves: normal form and tree diagram (leaf addresses, 0 = left, 1 = right).
